other.raw_materials: Fe, Co, Cr, Ni, and Cu metals of 99.9% purity

evidence.quote: Alloy ingots with a nominal composition of Fe5Co5CrNi14Cu75 (at%) were prepared using a vacuum arc melting furnace under argon protection using Fe, Co, Cr, Ni, and Cu metals of 99.9 % purity grade as raw materials.
To ensure the chemical composition homogeneity of the alloy, the ingots were remelted five times before being poured into copper molds to produce an alloy plate.
the ingots were remelted five times before being poured into copper molds to produce an alloy plate.
